texts: Added assists, levels, hp, speed, and offense and defense levels to encounters. I may have missed some encounters when adding levels, so some may have missing or incorrect values. They will be fixed if I notice them or if they're reported.
Added some missing passives to some encounters.
Added chat resizing. This is accessible in the chat widget's settings menu.
Disabled custom images in chat. Emotes and Stickers are still available.
Added a recovery method to Clash Arena for revealing round results. Skills that would crash the room should now return a 0 clash value instead.
Made a small layout change to the sanity section in identities and encounters.
Adjusted Middle Heathcliff's Complete and Total Extermination in Clash Arena to be available every 5 instead of every 4 turns.
Fixed an issue where disabling points during draft would cause Clash Arena to crash.

body.text: There seem to be some skills that may cause Clash Arena to crash when used. I've added a guard in the server so they should return a 0 clash value with no coins instead of crashing the room. If you experience this, please send a report with the skill used so I can review the broken skill.
